properties.name: A1460/26 / TDPD
properties.originalText:
HELICOPTER SLING OPERATIONS WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE LAUDAT AREA,
SOUTHERN PART OF THE ISLAND, BY HELICOPTER REGISTRATION N214B
BETWEEN BASE STATION 153256N0611648W AND SUMMIT STATION
153056N0611729W. FLIGHT PATHS BETWEEN THE OPERATIONAL ZONE AND TDPD
MAY BE CONDUCTED UP TO 3000FT AMSL AND WILL
BE COORDINATED WITH ATC.
PILOTS ARE ADVISED TO EXERCISE CAUTION AND MAINTAIN VIGILANCE FOR
HELICOPTER ACTIVITY IN THE VICINITY.
